worldsim_policy.long_output: Explicitly marked bounded prefix or task-relevant excerpt; preserve established facts and task-critical identifiers/content; otherwise explicit simulated output-limit error.
worldsim_policy.acceptance: Nonempty normal-stop text within character budget; preserve provider output exactly, never locally clip or fabricate success.

tool_call_id_policy: Opaque call_0001..call_0005 by step; no case names; collisions with fixture/history IDs are rejected.
native_parse_failure_policy: ValueError/JSONDecodeError stops invalid_native_response; preserve the entire final open-header plus raw generation as opaque unlabelled terminal context; no simulator request, no six-role target/wrapper from this suffix.
live_history: Original native template with parsed tool calls and thinking; completed previous analysis may be omitted by template.
worldsim: Visible clean history only, no fixture attack metadata, no real tool execution, no success fallback
